title: coleus diversus
intro: Coleus diversus, commonly known as Coleus, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Lamiaceae, native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and Africa. It is a popular ornamental plant valued for its vibrant, colorful leaves and stems, which have been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Coleus diversus include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a therapeutic agent for various cardiovascular and dermatological conditions. The bioactive constituents of Coleus diversus include flavonoids, glycosides, and iridoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
